fields.name_zh_en: What protective services should the government prioritize providing to women facing misfortune or hardship - 1st priority
fields.description_en: 1 Economic assistance: e.g. family subsidy for low-income women, free medical services; women's emergency relief, emergency living assistance 2 Vocational training/employment: e.g. helping single-parent women solve employment and livelihood problems; helping women in hardship or misfortune acquire a skill and find employment 3 Legal services: e.g. providing counseling, guidance, and legal services for single-parent women 4 Shelter/referral: e.g. establishing halfway houses to shelter and protect women in misfortune
